entry.name: jit.dimmap
entry.description: Provides remapping and/or inversion of matrix dimensions. Similar to the jit.transpose object, however any dimension may be mapped to any other dimension as well as inverted. Note that the input to output map may not contain any duplicates. Redundant dimensions of size 1 may be inserted by using a map value of -1 at the corresponding dimension index.
